description.value: The Fringe Café is Vancouver's oldest neighbourhood bar on West Broadway, established in 1990 and celebrated for its no-frills, laid-back atmosphere with an extensive selection of draft and bottled beers from around the world. Alongside its drinks, the bar serves a simple food menu of nachos, Jamaican patties, salads, and bar snacks that draws a loyal local crowd in the Kitsilano neighbourhood. Regular events — trivia nights, karaoke, open mic, and live music — make it a lively community hub for locals and visitors alike.
